messages:
maya: FYI scheduling an overnight maintenance window for az-east3 GPU pool-B, 23:30-02:30 UTC. target: staggered node reboots + NIC microcode + small BIOS micro-patch. want ops + support aware.

ryan: scope? how many nodes and seq?

maya: pool-B ~96 GPUs across 48 nodes. well do 8-node cohorts (cordon/drain/reboot/validate) with 2 warm canaries ahead of the run. expect ~12 cohorts.

tasha: canaries: how long do we soak and what tests?

maya: canary plan: seed top-5 KV prefixes, run 45m synthetic soak (simulated chat + embeddings), run perf sanity (p99 latency, tail errors). if canary looks good, proceed.

emily: customer impact? which routes touch this pool?

maya: primarily batch-embeddings-us-east2 and some secondary replicas for chat-us-east. product will post a banner; impact should be soft failures/latency for a small % if we divert.

ryan: fallback routing? prefer re-route to us-central. cost impact?

maya: policy reroute -> us-central-1. rough econ: cross-region egress + extra infra ~3-6% for window. can cut to ~2% if we pause non-critical batch workers.

marc: ops checklist (condensed):
```
- cordon node
- drain: kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
- BMC soft-reboot (ipmitool chassis power cycle)
- apply NIC microcode patch (kv: nic-fw-v3.2.1)
- small BIOS micro-patch apply if required
- run /health/runtime and p99 latency smoke
- run KV seed script for top prefixes
- uncordon node
```

emily: rollback criteria?

marc: abort and rollback if:
- sustained 2x p95 latency for 15m OR
- error-rate increase >4% sustained 10m OR
- canary fails health checks.

ops-bot: maintenance ticket INF-2026-320 created. oncall: @tasha assigned. :spiral_calendar:

tasha: I'll take on-call and watch dashboards. who sends the status update?

emily: support will publish T-2h status page + console banner for impacted routes; ops-bot will update start/finish.

ryan: compatibility note: if we need to shed load quickly, runtime-team prefers routing embeddings to quantized-8 variant to save infra. maya, can we validate quant-8 quality for the main prefix set?

maya: yes I'll run a quick QA pass during canary soak, if quality delta >2% we won't force it.

emily: dedicated customers billing note: reserved capacity shouldn't change billing; usage showing cross-region transfer will be visible on internal cost dashboards. ops-billing pinged.

marc: also flag: GPU driver version check - some nodes still on 525.x. we'll skip BIOS step on those and schedule follow-up patch to avoid driver incompat.

maya: good catch. will annotate cohort manifest. proceed unless someone objects in 20m. :thumbsup:

ryan: :+1:

emily: :thumbsup:

tasha: I'll stand by 22:50 UTC and start watch at 23:10 UTC.

maya: thanks team. will post canary soak results here and an incident-like short postmortem if we hit the abort threshold.
